name: a payment status bar fills beside an invoice list
looks: A small card shows a payment-status bar filling partway with a percentage label, beside a list of invoice rows beneath it, each with a date, a client name, a status tag and an amount, fading in top to bottom.
build: data-infographic's bar-growth pattern for the status bar (scaleX from a left origin on power3.out, percentage counting up with it); the invoice rows fade/slide in staggered beneath.
sound: A soft fill tone under the bar, a tick per invoice row.
prompt: Fill a small status bar partway with a percentage label, then list a few invoice or record rows beneath it fading in top to bottom, each with a date, a name, a status tag and an amount. Use it to show the current state of outstanding work at a glance.
